title: Forward frozen-spec mini-tournament (audit P1)
author: Research Agent (cloud)
status: FROZEN at freeze_ts in FREEZE.json; any edit to spec.json, entrants.py or research/frozen/evaluate.py voids the run
evidence_class: locked forward holdout: outcome bars open at or after the first UTC midnight after freeze_ts, all after the Research Agent's knowledge cutoff (2026-06)
venue_data: Kraken public OHLC interval 1440 (unauthenticated); close(t) = close of the bar opened at t - 1 day
universe_note: the 20 Kraken USD pairs of research/tsmom/ohlc_long.json, fixed now; survivorship relative to future delistings is handled by dropping a pair only when its bars stop (its last close is not used)

A1_S2_h5_timing_minus_static.hypothesis: T1/F3 S2 alone: holding LINK only when BTC close > SMA50(BTC) beats a STATIC position at the rule's own average LINK weight (live agent's request, 2026-09-25)
A1_S2_h5_timing_minus_static.decision: every 5 days from t0; w = 1 if BTC close(t) > mean of the 50 closes ending at close(t), else 0
A1_S2_h5_timing_minus_static.statistic: mean over non-overlapping 5-day windows of (timing net - static net); maker cost on |dw| after drift for both
null_controls: static exposure at the same average weight (built into the statistic)
hold-LINK (reported by the live agent's own ledger)

A2_X4_lowvol5_excess_vs_LINK.hypothesis: X4/X4b: an equal-weight basket of the 5 lowest-vol60 pairs of the frozen universe beats hold-LINK after costs
A2_X4_lowvol5_excess_vs_LINK.decision: every 28 days from t0; vol60 = sd of 60 daily log returns ending at close(t); pairs with vol60 < 0.5% excluded
A2_X4_lowvol5_excess_vs_LINK.statistic: mean over non-overlapping 28-day periods of (basket net - LINK); first period charged 2 maker legs, later periods maker cost on basket turnover
A2_X4_lowvol5_excess_vs_LINK.p: max(one-sided t-test > 0, share of random-5 baskets from the same universe with mean excess >= observed)

B1_tactical_candidates_all.hypothesis: the live tactical detector stream (tactical_v4 candidates, gate outcome ignored) has positive 3-day excess vs LINK net of the 4-leg round trip
B1_tactical_candidates_all.data: rows of the mirrored live ledgers with decision_ts_epoch (or opened_ts) > freeze_ts
B1_tactical_candidates_all.entry: close of the first UTC midnight after the decision (no intraday data)
B1_tactical_candidates_all.statistic: mean over decision days of the day's mean (3-day candidate return - 3-day LINK return - 1.83%)
B1_tactical_candidates_all.p: max(one-sided t-test > 0, share of random-entry draws (random frozen-universe pairs, same days and counts) >= observed)

B2_tactical_candidates_X4_lowvol.hypothesis: audit P1(a): the same stream restricted to candidates whose vol60 <= the frozen universe median at entry
B2_tactical_candidates_X4_lowvol.statistic: as B1 on the filtered subset

ledger_note: B1/B2 depend on the live agent mirroring data/counterfactual_ledger.json to main; if it is not mirrored they stay INSUFFICIENT_N. shadow_trades.json is not used (its rows are a subset chosen by the same detector and would double count).
multiplicity: Holm across the entrants that reach min_n at a review; the audit's max-stat permutation across entrants is replaced by Holm because entrants have different nulls

decision_rule.SUCCESS: Holm p < 0.05 AND mean >= MDE (2.8 x SE) at that review

honest_expectation: F4/F5: 200-790 days before a 1% net edge is resolvable; expect INSUFFICIENT_N/CONTINUE at the first reviews. The value is that any future positive is uncontaminated.
not_actionable_note: Spot only. A SUCCESS is evidence for the live agent to validate, not an instruction.
